integrity: Exact complete enumeration of 8008 six-element subsets and all 192 optimizer-to-optimizer distances; independently reconstructed via cube symmetries and coordinate words.
scientific_limitations: Finite four-dimensional cube only; exhaustive classification with a separately replayable Python 3 verifier. The previously known connected-domination/minimum-leaf correspondence is not claimed new. Full text of Chen–Syu (2012) was not accessible, leaving possible partial prior coverage; independent validation not performed.
title: Optimal connected-dominating backbones and their exchange geometry in the four-cube
